d: Short, choppy dark forest green hair with long bangs framing the face and a slight parting. Sharp, narrow almond-shaped eyes in a pale lime green hue, set on a youthful face with a neutral, focused expression. A slender build wearing a brown tunic with a light tan tattered cloak draped over the shoulders, paired with tan leather gloves. Accessories include a wooden bow and a quiver of arrows with dark grey fletching.
